mapper.sql: WITH case_base AS ( SELECT r.target_type, r.target_id, MAX(r.id) AS latest_report_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count, SUM(r.reason = 1) AS illegal_count, SUM(r.reason = 2) AS porn_count, SUM(r.reason = 3) AS advertising_count, SUM(r.reason = 4) AS false_info_count, SUM(r.reason = 5) AS other_count, SUM(r.status = 0) AS pending_count, MIN(r.created_at) AS first_reported_at, MAX(r.created_at) AS last_reported_at FROM report r WHERE r.target_type IN (1, 4) GROUP BY r.target_type, r.target_id ), case_view AS ( SELECT base.latest_report_id, CASE base.target_type WHEN 1 THEN 'post' ELSE 'comment' END AS target_type, base.target_id, CASE WHEN base.target_type = 1 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(p.title, ''), CONCAT('帖子 #', base.target_id)) ELSE CONCAT('评论 #', base.target_id) END AS title, LEFT(COALESCE(p.content, c.content, ''), 160) AS content_preview, COALESCE(p.user_id, c.user_id) AS author_id, COALESCE(author.nickname, '已注销用户') AS author_name, base.report_count, base.illegal_count, base.porn_count, base.advertising_count, base.false_info_count, base.other_count, CASE WHEN base.pending_count > 0 THEN 'pending' WHEN latest.status = 1 THEN 'violation' ELSE 'normal' END AS status, base.first_reported_at, base.last_reported_at, latest.handler_id, latest.handle_remark, latest.handled_at FROM case_base base JOIN report latest ON latest.id = base.latest_report_id LEFT JOIN post p ON base.target_type = 1 AND p.id = base.target_id LEFT JOIN comment c ON base.target_type = 4 AND c.id = base.target_id LEFT JOIN user_profile author ON author.id = COALESCE(p.user_id, c.user_id) )

where.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content_preview LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR author_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(target_id AS CHAR) = #{keyword})

mapper.select:
SELECT latest_report_id, target_type, target_id, title, content_preview, author_id, author_name, report_count, illegal_count, porn_count, advertising_count, false_info_count, other_count, status, first_reported_at, last_reported_at, handler_id, handle_remark, handled_at FROM case_view
ORDER BY latest_report_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT latest_report_id, target_type, target_id, title, content_preview, author_id, author_name, report_count, illegal_count, porn_count, advertising_count, false_info_count, other_count, status, first_reported_at, last_reported_at, handler_id, handle_remark, handled_at FROM case_view WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} LIMIT 1

WITH case_base AS ( SELECT target_type, target_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count, SUM(status = 0) AS pending_count FROM report WHERE target_type IN (1, 4) GROUP BY target_type, target_id ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pending_count > 0), 0) AS pending_cases, COALESCE(SUM(pending_count > 0 AND report_count >= 4), 0) AS urgent_cases, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE target_type IN (1, 4) AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS reports_today, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(target_type, ':', target_id)) FROM report WHERE target_type IN (1, 4) AND handled_at >= CURRENT_DATE) AS completed_today FROM case_base

SELECT r.id AS report_id, r.reporter_id, COALESCE(reporter.nickname, CONCAT('用户 #', r.reporter_id)) AS reporter_name, CASE r.reason WHEN 1 THEN '违规违法' WHEN 2 THEN '色情低俗' WHEN 3 THEN '广告骚扰' WHEN 4 THEN '虚假信息' ELSE '其他' END AS reason, r.remark, r.created_at FROM report r LEFT JOIN user_profile reporter ON reporter.id = r.reporter_id WHERE r.target_type = CASE #{targetType} WHEN 'post' THEN 1 ELSE 4 END AND r.target_id = #{targetId} ORDER BY r.id DESC
SELECT id FROM report WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
